canonicalEvidence.note: The Sep-1 CI artifact was downloaded and inspected using the same three-character EVSE party-prefix parser as scripts/audit_germany_evse_cpo_progress_v9.py. Removing the Tesla prefix yields the project canonical denominator 556.

resolvedNonCanonical.reason: No DE*SLS party prefix occurs in the Sep-1 CI-built BNetzA crosswalk. SLS strings found in the artifact occur only inside location-specific tails of EVSE IDs belonging to another party prefix (for example DE*443), so DE*SLS must not be added to the 556-CPO queue without new post-Sep-1 primary evidence.

deferred.missing: OPG officially confirms its own public charging network, QR ad-hoc charging, kWh billing and links a current tariff overview, but the current tariff is embedded as an image (Tabelle_Ladekosten_ab_2025-08) that could not be retrieved by the public fetch path. Station-level discovery sources confirm DE*OPG and ad-hoc availability but report the direct price as unknown; third-party eMSP prices are not valid CPO evidence.
deferred.unblock: A retrievable official OPG tariff table/image, reproducible OPG QR/direct-payment payload, Ladecloud public tariff payload, or another primary station-level source exposing the exact current price.

deferred.missing: The official inno2grid site describes infrastructure, software and operational services but publishes no consumer charging tariff. Public station-level discovery confirms DE*I2G ad-hoc capability; prices are often unknown and at least one station has a third-party reported value, which is insufficient to infer a network-wide tariff.
deferred.unblock: Primary inno2grid tariff documentation, reproducible DE*I2G QR/direct-payment payloads, or a public station-level backend/DATEX feed containing exact prices per EVSE.
